summary.text: Katie Muth is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 44 since December 1, 2018, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Melissa Dicranian.

paragraphs.text: Katie Muth succeeded Republican John Rafferty in District 44.

For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness, Community, Economic and Recreational Development, Environmental Resources and Energy, Finance, and State Government committees, and she chaired the Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness Committee in 2023 and 2024.
